title: Compliance Review Standard for Personal Sender Account Verification Documents
content:
Paloma takes verification documents for a Personal Sender Account only while the account status is pending verification, active or restricted; documents are not taken on a locked, suspended or closed account.

## Logging a document

A support agent logs a document the customer has uploaded in the app by its upload reference, exactly as the app shows it. The level the document supports is set to the requested level when the document supports an upgrade or a limit review, and to the current level otherwise. Each upload reference is logged once.

| Account status | Documents taken? |
|---|---|
| pending verification, active, restricted | yes |
| locked, suspended, closed | no |

## Review standards

Compliance reviews each document against the standards of the level it supports:

- a **proof of address** is accepted only when its issue date is no more than the level's proof-of-address age, in calendar days, before its received date;
- a **government ID** is accepted only when its expiry date is at least the level's remaining-validity figure, in calendar days, after its received date;
- a **source-of-funds document** is accepted only when its issue date is no more than the level's source-of-funds age, in calendar days, before its received date;
- **bank statements** are accepted only when the level's number of consecutive monthly statements are received and the latest one's issue date is no more than the level's bank-statement age, in calendar days, before its received date.

A document that fails a standard is rejected with the matching rejection reason — too old, expiring soon, expired, illegible, name mismatch or incomplete — and must be uploaded again as a new document with a new upload reference; a rejected document is never re-reviewed.

## Standing outcome of a document

The latest review of a document is its standing outcome; a document with no review is pending review. A document's acceptance never by itself changes the level, the limits or the account status.

## Hypothetical case

A customer whose account is at Paloma Verified Plus uploads a source-of-funds document in support of a limit review for Paloma Enhanced. It is logged with Paloma Enhanced as the level it supports, and compliance measures it against the Paloma Enhanced source-of-funds age. If it is rejected as too old, a fresh upload with a new upload reference is needed; the rejected document is not reviewed again.
